Why choose Cleveland Clinic?

We put patients first. That’s been our approach for more than 100 years — and we’re recognized in the U.S. and around the world for our expertise and innovation.

We don’t just care for your health. We care about you.

That means taking the time to listen, understand your needs and help you make confident decisions about your care.

We’re stronger together.

Our physicians and specialists work as one team to provide coordinated care, with a shared focus on achieving the best possible outcomes.

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow.

Research and innovation help us bring leading-edge treatments and clinical trials to you and your family, shaping the future of healthcare.

Comprehensive Hospital Charges

Learn more about the comprehensive hospital charges incurred for services at Cleveland Clinic.
  • Schedule Customer Service Callback
  • Pay a Bill
  • Need Financial Assistance?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

How Much Will My Upcoming Procedure or Exam Cost?

The information provided below is a comprehensive list of charges provided by our hospitals. In accordance with CMS regulations, we have also provided information on payer-specific negotiated rates, as well as the minimum and maximum negotiated charges by service, and the estimated self-pay amount. The hospital’s charges are the same for all patients, but a patient’s financial responsibility may vary due to a variety of factors, such as negotiated rates with individual health insurance companies and a patient’s out-of-pocket costs (i.e. deductible, co-insurance, copays, etc.). Uninsured or underinsured patients should consult with our patient financial advocates to determine whether they qualify for financial assistance.

For a real-time estimate of an upcoming procedure or exam, please use our cost estimator tool or speak with a patient financial advocate.

Are you a patient in Florida?

For patients in Florida who need to estimate the cost of an upcoming procedure or exam, please visit the following pages:

  • Coral Springs Shoppable Services
  • Indian River Hospital Shoppable Services
  • Cost Estimator Tool

The service bundle information is a non-personalized estimate of costs that may be incurred by the patient for anticipated services and that actual costs will be based on services actually provided to the patient.

The estimates provided are only related to your Cleveland Clinic providers. Your independent, personal physician or other physicians providing you with services related to your hospital stay or visit will bill you separately. These providers may or may not participate in the same health plans as the hospital. Please contact them directly to verify that they participate in your health plan. For contact details for these providers, please use our Find a Doctor search tools for Weston, Martin or Indian River.

If you would like to compare our charges to other providers please visit the following sites:

  • floridahealthfinder.gov
  • pricing.floridahealthfinder.gov

Visit our FAQs page for more information.

Are you a patient at one of our Rehabilitation Hospitals?

For patients at our Rehabilitation Hospitals who need to estimate the cost of an upcoming procedure or exam, please visit the following pages:

  • Cleveland Clinic Rehabilitation Hospital, Avon
  • Cleveland Clinic Rehabilitation Hospital, Beachwood
  • Cleveland Clinic Rehabilitation Hospital, Edwin Shaw
  • Cleveland Clinic Rehabilitation Hospital, Fairhill

The information is a non-personalized estimate of costs that may be incurred by the patient for anticipated services and that actual costs will be based on services actually provided to the patient.

The estimates provided are only related to your Cleveland Clinic providers. Your independent, personal physician or other physicians providing you with services related to your hospital stay or visit will bill you separately. These providers may or may not participate in the same health plans as the hospital. Please contact them directly to verify that they participate in your health plan.

Charge Lists for Cleveland Clinic Hospitals

Below is each hospital’s standard charge information for all services, posted June 29, 2026, unless noted. Please note, the comprehensive charges described in the files below are subject to change. To access this information, an application designed to handle large data files is recommended.

FAQs, Cost Estimator and More

Have Questions About Our Charge Lists?

See our list of frequently asked questions for more details about how to understand what is included in the hospital charge lists.

Need an Estimate for a Procedure?

Our online cost estimator can provide a real-time estimate of an upcoming procedure or exam at many of our hospitals.

How Much Does a COVID-19 Test Cost?

Find cost details from Cleveland Clinic for COVID-19 testing. Because health insurance coverage can change, please also check with your insurance company.

Have Additional Questions About Our Billing Process?

Visit our full list of frequently asked questions for billing and finance, including how to make a payment online or get assistance.

Our Services

Schedule an Appointment Find Care at Cleveland Clinic
Maybe you've heard about our heart care — or a friend recommended a beloved pediatrician. When you need a trusted healthcare provider, Cleveland Clinic experts are here for you.

Over the last 100 years, we’ve grown from a few good doctors with a vision to change healthcare to a globally integrated healthcare system. Innovating, researching and leading the way — our team brings you the best possible treatments. And throughout it all, we know this is a human experience. Our providers are by your side, answering your questions and supporting you however we can.

Though Cleveland is in our name, our reach expands beyond our homebase. We bring care not only to Ohio, but also Florida, Nevada, Toronto, London and Abu Dhabi.

From the lifesaving to the everyday, we’re here to help.

  • Virtual Care

    Life is busy. Sometimes you don’t have time to travel to an appointment. Or you may not feel well enough to leave home. We’ve got you covered. Virtual visits allow you to see a provider without heading into one of our physical locations. You can get a virtual visit for express care, primary care and pediatric primary care. Sometimes, you can even schedule a virtual appointment with a specialist instead of meeting in person.

    Get more information

  • Second Opinions

    There are times when you need more information. At Cleveland Clinic, we offer second opinions for a wide variety of conditions. Our experts can review your medical information and offer their recommendations. We also offer virtual second opinions if you can’t travel to one of our locations for an appointment.

    Learn more

  • Where to Go for Care

    Unsure if you need to schedule an appointment with a primary care provider, visit an express care or head to the emergency room? We can help point you toward the care you need.

    Find the right level of care

When you need a trusted healthcare provider, Cleveland Clinic experts are here for you. Over the last 100 years, we’ve grown from a few good doctors with a vision to change healthcare to a globally integrated healthcare system. Innovating, researching and leading the way — our team brings you the best possible treatments. And throughout it all, we know this is a human experience. Our providers are by your side, answering your questions and supporting you however we can. Though Cleveland is in our name, our reach expands beyond our homebase. We bring care not only to Ohio, but also Florida, Nevada, Toronto, London and Abu Dhabi. From the lifesaving to the everyday, we’re here to help.
